items.task: Create a real-life situation that uses choosing appropriate length units. Record the quantities and explain your reasoning.
Find one example at home/school of metre, centimetre, millimetre and kilometre. Draw or photograph the representation and label it.
Design a pair activity for converting length units. Each partner must explain the answer in a different way.
Collect two measurements or observations connected to comparing lengths and compare them.
Make a small poster teaching adding and subtracting mixed lengths to a younger learner. Include one worked example.
Invent a challenge based on distance, routes and unit price; exchange it with a classmate and check the solution.
